Hi Monica —

Quick handoff: we closed WellBridge Health (signed MRR, effective 10/1). High-level items for CS & implementation below — I want to get you set up as the primary owner and flag a couple of security blockers up front.

Deal highlights
- ACV: $420k ARR first year (committed Dedicated throughput + hosted fallbacks)
- Go-live target: 2026-10-15 (production traffic by 10/20)
- Primary contacts: Elaine Murray (Director, Product), Alex Chen (Platform lead)

Technical / security asks from procurement
- InfoSec needs: SOC 2 Type II attestation (we have SOC docs, will require an evidence call)
- Data residency: US-only; customer will request VPC dedicated routing for PHI-like telemetry
- API allowlist: WellBridge needs IP allowlist and an initial list of test IPs for staging

Expected workload
- Ramp to ~1.2M tokens/day over first 60 days, peak bursts up to ~600 requests/minute by week 4
- Latency SLO target: 500ms p95 for short replies; can accept batched jobs for embeddings

Attachments: SOW draft and initial kickoff agenda attached (see filenames below). Also linking HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/WB-0389

Requests for CS
1) Monica — take primary owner for onboarding + single point of contact for ops/security
2) Schedule a 60-minute kickoff with customer + your infra/security lead; propose 09/17 or 09/18
3) Coordinate a short evidence call with our compliance team for WellBridge InfoSec — they asked for a 30–45m sync next week

Notes / risks
- Customer expects Dedicated capacity; procurement will sign the Dedicated addendum but needs confirmation on routing and KMS options
- They want the SOW finalized before kickoff (attached: WellBridge_SOW_v1.pdf)

Next step: can you confirm owners and a kickoff slot? I can intro Elaine in the next email thread.

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Great, answers inline:
- Model: They asked for our high-throughput variant, rw-instruct-13B-v1 on Dedicated. Expect to evaluate rw-instruct-7B for some lower-latency routes.
- KMS: Procurement indicated preference for customer-managed keys (HSM) but they are open to Redwood KMS during staging. Please assume customer KMS in production planning.
- Test data: Alex confirmed staging will use de-identified data for training-like workflows and a small set of realistic sample payloads (no PHI). They will provide sanitized CSVs and example API payloads.
